FAQ.label: FAQ
FAQ.title: Questions You Might Have
FAQ.subtitle: Common questions about FluxMedia and how it works.

items.question: What is FluxMedia?
items.answer: FluxMedia is an AI-powered platform that turns natural-language conversations into high-quality images. Describe what you want, and our AI generates it — no prompt engineering required. Features include chat-to-image generation, a visual gallery, multi-model support, and pay-as-you-go billing.

items.question: Which AI image models are supported?
items.answer: FluxMedia supports the leading image generation models on the market, including GPT Image 2. Sign up and purchase prepaid credits to start generating — the platform handles model routing and delivers results in a unified interface.

items.question: How does the credits system work?
items.answer: Every image generation consumes credits based on the model and parameters you choose. Purchase prepaid credits in one-time transactions and top up whenever you need more.

items.question: How do I get started?
items.answer: Sign up for an account and purchase prepaid credits when you are ready; usage is billed according to the images you generate.

items.question: How is image generation billed?
items.answer: Images consume credits based on the selected model, size, and actual output. You pay for usage without a recurring fee.

items.question: Can I download and use the images commercially?
items.answer: Yes. Images you generate on FluxMedia are yours to use — for personal, editorial, or commercial projects. Downloads are available from your gallery, and your full generation history stays saved.
